book.title: MATYIW Jiysis Krays Minim Tep Matyiw Tikak

content: Pañ Piñ Onep Wanjrem Aŋgiy Paydoŋ Ay Aŋgak
“Gor biynimb diy kond mindeniŋgamb ñin kun ak; kesim diniŋg gispiyn biy rek giniŋgamb. Biyomb bap biyn diniŋg gek, tap yomb ñiŋniŋg biyn piñ onep wanjrem ak lam keykey diy dand amniŋgambay.
Biyn piñ kun gok, onep mamind ak gos tep niŋniŋgambay; onep mamind ak gos niŋrep ma giniŋgambay.
Niŋrep ma giniŋgambay kun gok, lam daŋgiyep wel gunap sek dand ma amniŋgambay.
Pen biyn piñ gos niŋrep giniŋgambay gok, lam diy, lam daŋgiyep wel gunap botol miŋgan ak paŋgiy, dand amniŋgambay.
Pen biyn piñ kun gok kiyk maŋgiysek amjakiy, kond mindey mindey, bi biyn diniŋg giniŋgamb ak kasek ma apeniŋgamb mey, wisin apek kinamniŋgambay.
“Pen kisyimnamb yomb biyaŋ, biynimb gunap suk aŋgiy aŋgniŋgambay, ‘Bi biyn diniŋg gisap ak asaw. Nup am kinjeŋnamb ak niŋiy, poŋind owim aŋgniŋgambay.’
Kun aŋgeniŋgambay, biyn tiwin onep wanjrem kun ak maŋgiysek tikjakiy, lam wiyk kiyk gok girep giniŋgambay.
Kun giy biyn gos niŋrep ma giniŋgambay tiwin ak, biyn gos niŋrep giniŋgambay tiwin ak kuyip aŋgniŋgambay, ‘Lam chin gok suŋgniŋg gisap ak; wel nimb gok chinup gunap ñim aŋgniŋgambay.’
Aŋgey biyn gos niŋrep giniŋgambay tiwin ak aŋgniŋgambay, ‘Mer! Wel kun gok, nimbip gunap ñiy, chin gunap dinjun rek ma ayip. Nimb stowa amiy, nimbik gok key tawim aŋgniŋgambay.’

Kun aŋgeniŋgambay wel tawniŋg stowa amniŋgambay won ak, bi biyn diniŋg giniŋgamb ak apchakeniŋgamb. Biyn gos niŋrep giniŋgambay tiwin ak, bi kun ak yip korip miŋgan ameniŋgambay; nuk kinjeŋ giñiniŋgamb.
Kisen pen biyn piñ gos niŋrep ma giniŋgambay tiwin ak apchakiy aŋgniŋgambay, ‘Biyomb! Biyomb! Chinup kinjeŋ ak yikan aŋgniŋgambay.’
Aŋgey, biyomb biyn nuk diniŋgamb ñin kun ak aŋgniŋgamb, ‘Yand nimbip ma niŋbiyn aŋgniŋgamb.’
Kun ak nimb Biyomb ak ñin akay akaŋ, won akay winiŋgamb ak ma niŋbim rek, minj moka giy mindenimimb.
Biyomb Bap Binuk Gok Kuyip Maniy Ñak Aŋgiy Paydoŋ Ay Aŋgak
“Pen kesim diniŋg gispiyn biy rek giniŋgamb. Biyomb bap miñmon paryomb okok amniŋg, bi woŋg nup giñiniŋgambay gok kuyip suk aŋgek apey, tap gok kond mindeyaŋ aŋgiy, kuyip ñiniŋgamb.

Binuk kun gok, woŋg keykey giniŋgambay rek niŋiy, maniy bilokiy, bi bap nup payp tawsin ñiniŋgamb, bap nup tiw tawsin ñiniŋgamb, bap nup wan tawsin ñiniŋgamb. Ñiy, nuk am okok mindakniŋ, bi payp tawsin diniŋgamb ak maniy kun ak diy, sikyim gi dand amiy apiy giy, maniy siyniŋ payp tawsin diniŋgamb.
Bi tiw tawsin diniŋgamb ak kunep, sikyim gi dand amiy apiy giy, maniy siyniŋ tiw tawsin diniŋgamb.
Pen bi maniy wan tawsin diniŋgamb ak, dand amiy, kaw tikiy lum ñiniŋgamb.
“Kisen mind dand amiy, biyomb kiyk ak andkind apiy, maniy ñimbiyn kun ak yerer gipay aŋgiy, kuyip aŋgniŋniŋgamb.

Aŋgniŋek, bi payp tawsin diniŋgamb ak, maniy nuk ak ñiy aŋgniŋgamb, ‘Biyomb niŋan! Yip maniy payp tawsin nep ñinak ak pen, yand maniy kun ak di, sikyim gi andik mandik giy, pen payp tawsin siyniŋ dipiyn aŋgniŋgamb.’
Aŋgek, biyomb ak pen aŋgniŋgamb, ‘Tep. Nand bi woŋg tep giñimban. Tap sikoy ak kun gipan ak, nip aŋgen tap yomb gok kond mindeniŋgamban. Ap korip yip ak miñmiñ yimb giyiŋg mindenimin aŋgniŋgamb.’

“Bi maniy tiw tawsin diniŋgamb ak kunep maniy nuk ak dap ñiy aŋgniŋgamb, ‘Biyomb. Yip tiw tawsin nep ñinak ak pen, yand maniy kun ak diy, sikyim gi andik mandik giy, maniy siyniŋ tiw tawsin dipiyn aŋgniŋgamb.’

“Aŋgek, biyomb ak aŋgniŋgamb, ‘Tep. Nand bi woŋg tep giñimban ak mey; kun gipan. Tap sikoy ak kun gipan ak, nip aŋgen tap yomb gok kond mindeniŋgamban. Ap korip yip ak miñmiñ yimb giyiŋg mindenimin aŋgniŋgamb.’
“Pen bi maniy wan tawsin diniŋgamb ak dap ñiy aŋgniŋgamb, ‘Biyomb. Yand nip niŋbiyn; nand bi kalrimey yimb. Biynimb nak gunap woŋg wariy kiyk gipay gok nand yikop pipaŋg dapiy ñimban.
Nand kun gipan rek, yand pirikiy, maniy ñinak ak dand amiy, kaw tikiy lum ñen mindyiŋgip ak, miñiy dand aswiyn aŋgniŋgamb.’
“Aŋgek biyomb ak aŋgniŋgamb, ‘Nand bi timey woŋg magep bap. Yand biynimb gunap woŋg gipay gok nep dapiy ñimben niŋban kun ak;
yenen maniy yip biy dam pasbuk ayey, miñiy apiy maniy siyniŋ gunap sek ma dipiyn?’
Kun aŋgiy, binuk gunap kuyip aŋgniŋgamb, ‘Kun gip ak, maniy wan tawsin kun ak jiw diy, bi payp tawsin ñinik ak nup ñinimimb.
Per apun rek: Biynimb gin yimb gok kuyip gunap sek ñey mindrep giniŋgambay; pen biynimb gin mer gok, kuyip siskoy nind aŋgayak ak piliŋg dey, yikop yimb mindeniŋgambay.
Kun ak bi woŋg ma gip kun anup kisyim yomb wip mis ar akyaŋ yokem, biynimb meŋg siwbirikiy, siy aŋgmindpay gok yip siy aŋg mindeŋ aŋgniŋgamb’ aŋgak.”
Kor Yomb Kisen Ak
Bi bap Ñinuk kiyŋ yomb mindiy winiŋgamb ñin ak, enjol gok yip maŋgiysek apiy, nuk siya kiyŋ ar ak bisgek,

biynimb miñmon okok keykey mindpay rek, ap windin yirik ar nup siŋak nan-geniŋgambay, kuyip bilok pis ak key, pis ak key ayniŋgamb. Bi kanj siypsiyp meymey mokep gok, siypsiyp gok wikan bap tuŋgasik ay, meymey gok wikan bap key tuŋgasik ay gipay rek ak giniŋgamb.
Biynimb siypsiyp rek mindpay gok niŋiy, ñin yipund kind ak ayniŋgamb; biynimb meymey rek mindpay gok niŋiy, ñin aŋind kind ak ayniŋgamb.
Nuk kiyŋ yomb ak mey, biynimb tep gok kuyip aŋgniŋgamb, ‘Bapiy nimbip niŋimb. Wosrey nuk miñmon alwol gayak ñin ak, tip nimbip gayak ak mey, apiy tip tep kun ak dim.
Yenen: yip yiwan gek, tap keñmaŋgiy ñimbim. Ñiŋg nen gek, ñiŋg ñimbim. Miñmon par okok nimb apen, yip aŋgdiy di korip nimbik ak aypim.
Chech ma mindek, yip chech ak ñimbim. Yip tap gek, niŋmindrep gipim. Kalambis minden, yip ap niŋbim aŋgniŋgamb.’
“Kun aŋgeniŋgamb, biynimb tep gok nup pen aŋgniŋgambay, ‘Biyomb. ñin akay nip yiwan gek keñmaŋgiy ñimbun? Ñin akay ñiŋg nen gek, nip ñiŋg ñimbun?
Ñin akay par okok nimb apey, nip aŋgdiy dam korip chin ak aypun. Ñin akay chech ak ma mindek, nip chech ñimbun?
Ñin akay tap gek akaŋ, kalambis mindey, nip am niŋbun?’
“Aŋgeniŋgambay, kiyŋ yomb ak aŋgniŋgamb, ‘Mam yip yikop gunap kuyip girep gipim ak mey, yip girep gipim aŋgniŋgamb.’

Kuyip kun aŋgiy, biynimb aŋind kind okok ken mindeniŋgambay gok kuyip aŋgniŋgamb, ‘Bapiy Gor Seytan nup sek, Seytan enjol nuk gok sek kuyip yiwur gakniŋ mindeyaŋ aŋgiy, tip mon key yinjap bap gayak. Nimb biynimb timey yiwur yomb diniŋgambim gok, yip kirgiy, mon key yinjap kun ak amnimimb.
“Yenen: yip yiwan gek, tap keñmaŋgiy ma ñimbik. Ñiŋg nen gek, ñiŋg ma ñimbik.
Par okok nimb apen, yip ma aŋgdipik. Chech ma mindek; yip ma ñimbik. Yip tap gak ñin ak akaŋ, kalambis mindenik ñin ak, yip ma ap niŋbik aŋgniŋgamb.’

“Aŋgeniŋgamb, nup aŋgniŋgambay, ‘Biyomb. Ñin akay yiwan mindenak nip keñmaŋgiy ma ñinuk? Ñin akay ñiŋg nen gek nip ñiŋg ma ñinuk? Ñin akay okok nimb apey nip ma aŋgdinuk? Ñin akay chech nip ma mindek, nip ma ñinuk? Ñin akay tap gek akaŋ, kalambis mindenak, nip ma am niŋnuk?’
“Kun aŋgeniŋgambay, kiyŋ ak aŋgniŋgamb, ‘Nimb mam yip yikop gok kuyip direp ma gipik rek mey, yip sek gipik aŋgniŋgamb.’
Kun aŋgiy, kuyip aŋgyokek am tip pernep yiwur gakniŋ mindeniŋgambay ak amniŋgambay. Pen biynimb tep nuk gok aŋgek, perper mindeniŋgambay tip ak amniŋgambay aŋgak.”
